$comment: Which XML containers may have their child elements sorted, and by what key.
This is an ALLOWLIST on purpose. Dataverse exports some collections in a
non-deterministic order (harmless to sort) and others in a meaningful one
(destructive to sort). Form layout, ribbon definitions and sitemap ordering
are positional: sorting them changes what the user sees, or breaks import.
Anything not listed here is left exactly as exported.
container : XPath selecting the parent element whose children get sorted.
child     : element name to sort. Other children are left in place.
keys      : ordered list of sort keys, tried in order. A key is either
'@attribute' or a child element name. Elements missing every
key sort by their own XML, which is stable but arbitrary.
Add rules cautiously, and confirm with a round trip against a real
environment that the solution still imports before trusting a new one.
